name: Slashing Blade
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level bard 2, bloodrager 2, lathspell 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a metal slashing weapon)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Effect 60 ft. line
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You throw your weapon and it spins and slashes through all enemies in the line. Each enemy must be attacked separately with a standard melee attack except you substitute your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls. Regardless of the number of hits or misses, the weapon returns to your hand.
